title: Tiny, cute piano
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='bodyGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#c0506a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#8a2f4a'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='topGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#e0708a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#b84868'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='keyGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffffff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#d8e0f0'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='blackKeyGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#5a4a7a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#3a2a5a'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Piano legs -->
  <rect x='18' y='78' width='8' height='14' rx='3' fill='#a04060'/>
  <rect x='74' y='78' width='8' height='14' rx='3' fill='#a04060'/>
  <rect x='46' y='78' width='8' height='14' rx='3' fill='#a04060'/>

  <!-- Piano body -->
  <rect x='10' y='40' width='80' height='42' rx='10' fill='url(#bodyGrad)'/>

  <!-- Body highlight -->
  <rect x='14' y='44' width='72' height='6' rx='3' fill='#d8607a' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- Top lid -->
  <rect x='8' y='32' width='84' height='14' rx='7' fill='url(#topGrad)'/>
  <rect x='14' y='35' width='72' height='4' rx='2' fill='#f090a8' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- White keys area -->
  <rect x='16' y='52' width='68' height='24' rx='4' fill='#e8eef8'/>

  <!-- White keys -->
  <rect x='18' y='54' width='8' height='20' rx='2' fill='url(#keyGrad)'/>
  <rect x='27' y='54' width='8' height='20' rx='2' fill='url(#keyGrad)'/>
  <rect x='36' y='54' width='8' height='20' rx='2' fill='url(#keyGrad)'/>
  <rect x='45' y='54' width='8' height='20' rx='2' fill='url(#keyGrad)'/>
  <rect x='54' y='54' width='8' height='20' rx='2' fill='url(#keyGrad)'/>
  <rect x='63' y='54' width='8' height='20' rx='2' fill='url(#keyGrad)'/>
  <rect x='72' y='54' width='8' height='20' rx='2' fill='url(#keyGrad)'/>

  <!-- Black keys -->
  <rect x='24' y='54' width='5' height='12' rx='2' fill='url(#blackKeyGrad)'/>
  <rect x='33' y='54' width='5' height='12' rx='2' fill='url(#blackKeyGrad)'/>
  <rect x='51' y='54' width='5' height='12' rx='2' fill='url(#blackKeyGrad)'/>
  <rect x='60' y='54' width='5' height='12' rx='2' fill='url(#blackKeyGrad)'/>
  <rect x='69' y='54' width='5' height='12' rx='2' fill='url(#blackKeyGrad)'/>

  <!-- Cute face on the body -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='72' r='3' fill='#ffe0e8'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='72' r='3' fill='#ffe0e8'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='72' r='1.5' fill='#3a1a2a'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='72' r='1.5' fill='#3a1a2a'/>
  <path d='M 44 76 Q 50 80 56 76' stroke='#ffe0e8' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- Cheek blush -->
  <ellipse cx='33' cy='75' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#ff8098' opacity='0.5'/>
  <ellipse cx='67' cy='75' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#ff8098' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- Music notes floating -->
  <g fill='#ffe870' opacity='0.9'>
    <path d='M 82 22 L 82 14 L 90 12 L 90 20 Z' />
    <ellipse cx='80' cy='22' rx='3' ry='2.5' />
    <ellipse cx='88' cy='20' rx='3' ry='2.5' />
  </g>
  <g fill='#a0e8ff' opacity='0.8'>
    <path d='M 12 20 L 12 12 L 20 10 L 20 18 Z' />
    <ellipse cx='10' cy='20' rx='3' ry='2.5' />
    <ellipse cx='18' cy='18' rx='3' ry='2.5' />
  </g>

  <!-- Sparkles -->
  <g fill='#fff0a0'>
    <circle cx='8' cy='40' r='1.5'/>
    <circle cx='92' cy='38' r='1.5'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='26' r='1.5'/>
  </g>
</svg>
